headline_finding: V2 IS NOT FULLY MIGRATED. Core trainer, RL environment, MASA/PPO architecture, reward functions, feature computation, native ingestors, orchestrator arbitration, and stop/TP engines are NOT migrated. The 18-completed-worker claim in worker_porting_state.json overstates readiness for shutdown evaluation.

rows.audit_finding: rl/hybrid_trainer.py (57,250 lines) wraps PPO+MASA, GPU env, SB3 loop. V2 has a subprocess wrapper only; no native PyTorch model, no SB3 policy, no GPU loop.
rows.current_claimed_state: v2_trainer_bridge listed as completed_worker; trainer_parity domain present
rows.exact_blocker: Native PPO+MASA training loop is missing. Subprocess wrapper does not satisfy migration completion contract clauses 6 (V2 implementation) and 7 (tests cover legacy-equivalent behavior).

rows.audit_finding: rl/environment.py (1,455), rl/gymnasium_wrapper.py (343), rl/obs_schema.py (~150), rl/unified_feature_builder.py (710) - tensor assembly and env step/reset/reward loop. V2 has domain models only (FeatureSnapshot, manifest, freshness). No tensor builder.
rows.exact_blocker: V2 lacks Gymnasium env, action space, observation tensor builder, and reward signal. Domain models do not constitute a runnable env.

rows.audit_finding: rl/agents/masa_agent.py (520), rl/enhanced_architectures.py (~600), rl/gpu_cnn_policy.py (~400), rl/gpu_forced_ppo.py (~350), rl/stable_gpu_trainer.py (~800), rl/moe_router.py (~300). 0% migrated.
rows.exact_blocker: No V2 PyTorch model, no SB3 policy, no custom CNN extractor exists. Cannot claim native parity.

rows.audit_finding: rl/reward_functions.py (902), rl/constrained_reward.py (~250), rl/fee_ratio_reward_shaping.py (~200), rl/hedge_reward_functions.py (~300), rl/metrics_tracker.py (~400), rl/continuous_learner.py (~500). 0% migrated.
rows.exact_blocker: V2 has paper edge scoring (outcome measurement) but not reward shaping for RL. No constrained reward, no fee-ratio shaping, no metrics decomposition.

rows.audit_finding: feature_pipeline.py (1,437 lines) runs as live daemon at legacy bot; writes 2000+ features:* keys to Redis. V2 has a thin adapter (15 lines) that converts payloads to domain objects; does not compute features.
rows.exact_blocker: V2 reads legacy feature pipeline output from Redis. No native v2 feature computation. The completed-worker label is misleading.

rows.audit_finding: 9 live ingestors running at legacy bot (Binance, Binance liquidations, CoinAnk, KuCoin, TA, realtime price, CoinAPI v1, CoinAPI WSDS, TokenMetrics stopped). V2 has CLI workers that bridge existing Redis data; no native WebSocket/REST.
rows.exact_blocker: V2 has no native ingestors. All live data flows through legacy ingestors writing legacy Redis. Bridge workers cannot satisfy contract clause 6 (V2 implementation) for the ingest layer itself.

rows.audit_finding: rl/orchestrator_worker.py (10,523), rl/proposal_bus.py (~400), rl/tradeplan_orchestrator.py (~600), rl/intent_engine.py (~500). V2 has decision record schema + API; arbitration logic (signal scoring, regime filtering, signal routing) is NOT ported.
rows.exact_blocker: 10,523 lines of arbitration logic absent in V2. The decision record schema is not the arbitration engine.

rows.audit_finding: trading/ has 35 files including trader.py (18,000+), stealth_stops.py, dynamic_tp_engine.py, dynamic_adaptive_stops.py, execution_engine.py, leg_manager.py, hedge builders, etc. V2 has paper intent + paper fill models only; exchange adapters are empty stubs.
rows.current_claimed_state: v2_paper_execution_worker, v2_execution_ledger_worker, v2_p2_default_blocked_execution_adapter_stub, v2_p2_binance_usdm_adapter_stub listed as completed_workers
rows.exact_blocker: Live execution is 0% migrated and intentionally gated. Paper-only layer is honest. Do not call execution-engine 'completed'.

rows.audit_finding: trading/stealth_stops.py, dynamic_adaptive_stops.py, dynamic_tp_engine.py, stealth_dynamic_integration.py, exit_coordinator.py, churn_prevention.py. Not ported to V2.
rows.exact_blocker: No V2 native paper-first stop/TP/stealth exit engine exists. Required for paper-shadow soak to converge realistically.

rows.audit_finding: rl/advanced_risk_management.py, rl/liquidation_prevention.py, rl/global_safety_checks.py, rl/dynamic_position_sizing.py, rl/hedge_budget_governor.py. V2 has risk gateway framework; liquidation prevention, dynamic position sizing, Kelly criterion are not ported.
rows.exact_blocker: Risk gateway framework exists. Deep risk logic missing. The Lane C 22-passing deny tests confirm framework parity for 11 paths, with 3 documented parity gaps (fee_ratio_gate, churn_veto, minimum_hold_time).

rows.audit_finding: Legacy config.py is 6,006 lines: SYMBOLS, TIMEFRAMES, feature flags, API keys, confidence thresholds, sizing parameters, account configs, GPU settings. V2 config_admin scaffolded but parameter set not formally ported.
rows.exact_blocker: Legacy config.py remains source of truth for running services. V2 config schema/env system not formally validated against the 6,006-line parameter set.

rows.audit_finding: 21 legacy utils. ~5 migrated (redis_client, logger, signal_publish, signal_schema, healthbeat). Missing: data_manager, data_normalizer, symbol_manager (partial), ai_coins_manager, decision_bus (partial), metrics, runtime_flags, preflight, ensemble_diagnostics, binance_rate_limiter, unified_position_loader, interrupt_lock, interpreter_guard, websocket_limits.
rows.exact_blocker: Multiple utils unported. Some are required by future native ingestors (websocket_limits, binance_rate_limiter).

rows.audit_finding: rl/hedge_*, trading/adaptive_hedge_*, trading/dynamic_adaptive_hedge.py, trading/hedge_pair_coordinator.py, rl/dynamic_position_sizing.py. Not ported.
rows.exact_blocker: No V2 hedge construction, no Kelly/volatility sizing.

implications_for_legacy_shutdown: Legacy ingestors must continue to run because V2 has no native ingestors.
Legacy feature_pipeline.py must continue to run because V2 has no native feature computation.
Legacy hybrid_trainer.py must continue to run because V2 has no native PPO+MASA.
Legacy orchestrator_worker.py must continue to run because V2 has no native arbitration.
Legacy trader.py being stopped is acceptable because V2 paper-only does not rely on it.
Therefore: legacy shutdown is NOT safe. Approves_legacy_shutdown remains false.
implications_for_live: Native trainer is missing: V2 cannot drive live decisions.
Native feature computation is missing: V2 cannot derive its own evidence.
Native orchestrator arbitration is missing: V2 cannot arbitrate without legacy.
Exchange adapters are empty stubs by design: V2 cannot execute live.
Live remains blocked_human_only. Approves_live remains false.
